# OpenPrintTag specification test vectors

`0N_data.bin` are full NFC tag memory images (ISO 15693 CC + NDEF TLV) copied
unmodified from `tests/encode_decode/` of
https://github.com/OpenPrintTag/openprinttag-specification at commit
`060e420892d66c062c8af440c97701aab96bac79`, licensed MIT. Expected values used in `spec_vectors_test.go` come
from the matching `0N_input.yaml` / `0N_info.yaml` files in that directory.
